gloss: to shatter; to smash; to dash (hopes)

definitions.gloss: to shatter; to smash to pieces
definitions.explanation: To break something hard into fragments with force. The prefix {打|う}ち〜 adds vigor to {砕|くだ}く, so the breaking is decisive and complete.

definitions.gloss: to dash; to crush (hopes, dreams, illusions)
definitions.explanation: To destroy something abstract that someone was holding on to, such as a dream, an expectation, or a belief. This figurative use is the more common one in writing.

examples.english: To smash the rock to pieces.

examples.japanese: {波|なみ}が{岸壁|がんぺき}を{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く{勢|いきお}いだった。
examples.english: The waves had enough force to smash the quay.

examples.japanese: {職人|しょくにん}は{大|おお}きな{石|いし}を{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}いて、{庭|にわ}に{敷|し}く{砂利|じゃり}にした。
examples.english: The craftsman smashed the large stones and turned them into gravel for the garden.

examples.japanese: {夢|ゆめ}を{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}かれた。
その{一言|ひとこと}が{彼|かれ}の{希望|きぼう}を{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}いた。
examples.english: That one remark dashed his hopes.

examples.japanese: {最終|さいしゅう}{戦|せん}での{敗北|はいぼく}は、{優勝|ゆうしょう}への{期待|きたい}を{完全|かんぜん}に{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}いた。
examples.english: The defeat in the final match completely shattered hopes of winning the championship.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive
- Pattern: Xを{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く
- The passive {打|う}ち{砕|くだ}かれる is very common in the figurative sense, since the person is usually the one whose hopes were crushed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夢|ゆめ}を{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く: to shatter someone's dream
- {希望|きぼう}を{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く: to dash hopes
- {幻想|げんそう}を{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く: to shatter an illusion
- {岩|いわ}を{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く: to smash a rock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {砕|くだ}く: to crush — the plain verb, without the force and finality of {打|う}ち〜
- {粉砕|ふんさい}する: to pulverize — Sino-Japanese and more technical, also used of crushing an opponent
